resources.string: Your vault asks for your PIN and your credential password together at least once every %1$s. Until you check, the app shows nothing from your vault.
Enter your PIN and your credential password. Your next check is then due %1$s from now.
Turning the hold off is part of a check: enter your PIN and your credential password.

When a check is late, your vault normally holds: your desktops and agents stop, calls do not ring and you do not appear online. With the hold off they keep running until the hold is back on, your vault locks or you check. Someone with your unlocked phone could keep a desktop or agent working for you. This phone still asks for the check before you can use it.
When I turn it back on
Nothing new has arrived since your check was due.
Your vault is held: it keeps receiving for you, but your desktops and agents wait for your check and calls do not ring.
The hold is off: your desktops and agents keep running. This phone needs the check first.
